in_sanskrit.name: वर्तिका
in_sanskrit.meaning: रात्रिकायां वर्तमाना - रात्रिका (Night) + वर्तमाना (present) = One who is present during the night
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is present or stays during the night.

in_hindi.name: वर्तिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: रात्रि (Night) + वर्तमाना (present) = रात्रिका (Night Goddess) + वर्तमाना (present) = The one who is present or stays during the night.

in_tamil.name: வர்த்திகா
in_tamil.meaning: இரவு (Night) + இருக்கும் (present) = The one who stays during the night
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who stays or is present during the night.

in_telugu.name: వర్తికా
in_telugu.meaning: ఇయలేదు (Night) + ఏదే (present) = The one who is present during the night
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is present or stays during the night.

in_marathi.name: Vartika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vartika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vartika is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vartika’, which means ‘autumn leaves’. In Hinduism, autumn is considered as a time of transition and change. The name Vartika signifies the transformation and growth that occurs during this time.
